Latin word

fortasse

adverb

maybe, perhaps

In this lexicon

  • perhaps

    the recommended word · classical · Cic. Div. Caec. 40: fortasse dīcēs

Notes

  1. 1Why fortasse, not fortassē: Lewis & Short prints a long final e but gives no evidence. De Vaan (2008: 236, s.v. fors) speaks of the word’s “short final vowel”, and verse proves it. In Catullus 85.1, Ōdī et amō. quārē id faciam fortasse requīris, the fifth foot -tasse re- must be a dactyl, so the e is short; Horace scans it the same way (S. 1.3.20, 1.6.98). Ruling: fortasse with a short final e.
